title: Total smart truncations identify naturally with the decalage tower
statement: For a Grothendieck abelian category C, a first-quadrant integer-indexed bicomplex J in C and a filtration L of its total whose degreewise steps are the second filtration, the totals of the extended horizontal smart truncations of J form a tower naturally isomorphic to the decalage tower of L. The isomorphism commutes with every bicomplex map and every filtered lift of its total map, and induces an isomorphism of the mapping-cone cohomology spectral objects.

source.document: Stacks Project, Homological Algebra and Derived Categories

proof.text: At finite cutoff a use the proved total-truncation/decalage isomorphism with q=a-1, since -(a-1)=1-a. At minus infinity use zero; at plus infinity invert the top-subobject arrow. Each component commutes with inclusion in the full total.

Cancel the target monic subobject inclusion to prove cutoff and comparison naturality. Applying the mapping-cone spectral-object functor and homology transports the entire natural tower isomorphism, including connecting arrows.

lean.statement:
theorem smartTruncationDecalageTowerIso_naturality
    {J J' : HomologicalComplex₂ C (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ)} (f : J ⟶ J')
    (hJ : ∀ i j : ℤ, i < 0 ∨ j < 0 → IsZero ((J.X i).X j))
    (hJ' : ∀ i j : ℤ, i < 0 ∨ j < 0 → IsZero ((J'.X i).X j))
    (L : DecreasingFiltration (J.total (.up ℤ)))
    (L' : DecreasingFiltration (J'.total (.up ℤ)))
    (hL : ∀ p n : ℤ, L.complexStep p n = (J.secondFiltration n).step p)
    (hL' : ∀ p n : ℤ, L'.complexStep p n = (J'.secondFiltration n).step p)
    (t : (⟨J.total (.up ℤ), L⟩ : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ)) ⟶
      (⟨J'.total (.up ℤ), L'⟩ : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ)))
    (ht : t.hom = total.map f (.up ℤ)) :
    smartTruncationTowerMap f ≫ (J'.smartTruncationDecalageTowerIso hJ' L' hL').hom =
      (J.smartTruncationDecalageTowerIso hJ L hL).hom ≫
        DecreasingFiltration.decalageTowerMap t
